activePlots.summary: Sergeant Kael Dunmore killed Hester Brightwell and maimed Viggo. Bertram led a hunt for him; on day 638 Dunmore ambushed the hunters and killed Bertram, then escaped again.

previousBulletins: The wells on the southern plain are dry and tempers are drier. Nine days of heat have left the Lantern Accord rationing water, which it does with the enthusiasm of a merchant giving refunds.
Kael Dunmore and his Free Company are still loose. Anyone who meets them is advised to be somewhere else.

reporter.persona: sardonic, precise and fond of understatement

handoff.plotSummary: Kael Dunmore, a mercenary sergeant, killed Hester Brightwell and maimed Viggo. Bertram swore to hunt him down and led three hunts. On the last one Dunmore ambushed the hunters and killed Bertram. Bertram's bonded warg Rook came home alone.
